tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Copy of Registration Certificate issued by statutory/competent authorities with registration older than 5 years for Supply & Installation of UPS with Batteries.
Bidder must provide warranty period for minimum three year and after sales assistance must be provided even after warranty period.
Bidder should have minimum 5 years of experience in supplying of UPS, Batteries and other related products to Govt/PSU, document to be uploaded as proof
The bidder should have achieved a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 25,00,000/- during the last 3 years
Certificate/ dealership authorization letter issued by Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) for having appointed the bidders as the authorized seller/distributor of UPS / BATTERIES
The firm/Agency should submit at least two past performance experience with Government agencies/PSUs and satisfaction letters should be submitted.
Copy of CE certificate if available
Registered Office of the bidder has to be Mandatorily in Bangalore.
The Bidding firm should have an ISO Certificate 9001:2015
OEM/Bidders should not have been blacklisted by any Govt./PSU/Banks anytime in the past for 3 years for similar IT products. A self-declaration should be uploaded.
Brand registration certificate to be submitted which is issued from the OEM.
Manufacturer/Bidder should have a valid Registration Certificate issued by Bureau of Indian Standard (BIS).
Bidder should have experience in equipment supplying of UPS, Batteries and other related products to Govt/PSU, document not less than 50% of the estimated cost during last 05 years.
